notes:
Background: Aurora BridgeWorks builds an in-app knowledge layer for mid-market B2B SaaS customers (ticket deflection, guided workflows). VP Product Samir Rao and Head of ML Priya Nair sponsor the project.

What they told us / call highlights:
- "Start with Hosted API to get fast feedback, then move to Dedicated for consistent QPS and data isolation." (explicit ask from Samir).
- Primary interest: reranking endpoint to post-process candidate sets from their retrieval pipeline. They want relevance tuning hooks (weights, feature injection) + offline scoring for nightly retraining.
- Targets: p95 latency for rerank < 120ms (prefer <100ms), peak QPS ~ 350 for peak windows, daily offline batch up to 2M doc-query pairs. Cost-sensitive — care about tokens-per-req economics for rerank.
- Model preferences: open LLMs initially (Llama2-variant, Mistral) for hosted eval; open to Redwood-curated variants with quantization. Need guidance from Redwood Optimize on quantization vs quality trade-offs.
- Security: SSO/SAML for user access, KMS for customer keys, audit logs for model invocations. Also asked about EU data residency for a subset of their customers (legal holds).
- Evaluation/POC scope: 1) hosted API rerank POC using their 10k test queries (sanitized) + Redwood's rerank endpoint; 2) offline scoring pipeline to validate nightly runs; 3) performance profiling and cost estimate for Dedicated nodes if we move forward.
- "We need a realistic offline scoring example that can run on our infra—show us sample Airflow DAG and cost calc." - Priya.

Risk notes / internal sales hints:
- Procurement will push on price for Dedicated; they want a clear migration path and credits for the Hosted phase.
- Security is a gating item — Tom Hsu (infra) flagged SOC2 controls and KMS integration as must-haves.
- They will ask for an SLA on failover behavior when we demo Dedicated (automatic fallback to compatible model variants).

Stubs / links mentioned during calls: drive pricing deck, eval set spreadsheet, Jira INF-2431 for hosting performance question.

- Prep security appendix for KMS/data residency for legal (Lena to coordinate).
